2. The short fact for disposal of the Rule is that the petitioners instituted the pre-emption case in the Court of Subordinate Judge, 1st Court, Chittagong against the opposite parties under Section 24 of the East Bengal Non-Agricultural Tenancy Act for pre-empting the land described in the schedule of the case. The pre-emptor during pendency of the pre-emption case filed an application under Order 6 Rule 17 CPC praying for amendment of the pre-emption application. 

 8. Mr. Md. Fazlul Karim, the learned Senior Advocate appearing on behalf of the opposite parties with the leave of the Court has taken rite to sub-Section 9 of Section 2-1 of the Non-Agricultural Tenancy Act and submits that the Rule is not competent in view of the provision of the Non-Agricultural Tenancy Act as the same provides for appeal and in that view of the matter the appeal lies but no revision lies under Section 115 CPC and as such the Rule may be discharged as not being maintainable. 

 9. "Section 24(9) of the Non-Agricultural Tenancy Act runs thus:- 

 It is found from sub-Section 9 of Section 24 of the Non-Agricultural Tenancy Act as quoted above an appeal from any order of a Court under this section shall lie to the Civil Appellate Court having jurisdiction to entertain such appeals.
